items.question: Trong câu "People often talk about "the user" as though users were a monolithic group.", từ "monolithic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People often talk about "the user" as though users were a monolithic group.", what does "monolithic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: monolithic /ˌmɑː.nəˈlɪθ.ɪk/ (tính từ): đồng nhất, nguyên khối. "A monolithic group" = một nhóm được xem như một khối thuần nhất; trong phần mềm còn gặp "monolithic architecture" (kiến trúc nguyên khối).
items.explanationEn: monolithic /ˌmɑː.nəˈlɪθ.ɪk/ (adjective): forming one single uniform whole. "A monolithic group" is treated as one uniform block; in software you also meet "monolithic architecture".

items.question: Trong câu "In reality, most products of any size serve several distinct user groups with different expectations and goals.", từ "distinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In reality, most products of any size serve several distinct user groups with different expectations and goals.", what does "distinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (tính từ): khác biệt, riêng biệt. "Distinct groups" = các nhóm tách biệt rõ ràng; cụm hay gặp: "distinct from" (khác với).
items.explanationEn: distinct /dɪˈstɪŋkt/ (adjective): clearly separate and different. "Distinct groups" are clearly separate ones; a common pattern is "distinct from" (different from).

items.question: Trong câu "Access privilege or security level (ordinary user, guest user, administrator).", từ "privilege" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Access privilege or security level (ordinary user, guest user, administrator).", what does "privilege" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a right to access or act
items.explanation: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): quyền hạn (truy cập). "Access privilege" = quyền truy cập; "least privilege" = nguyên tắc quyền tối thiểu.
items.explanationEn: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (noun): a right to access or act. "Access privilege" is the right to access something; "least privilege" is a core security principle.

items.question: Trong câu "But those are market segments, not user classes.", từ "segment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But those are market segments, not user classes.", what does "segment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a part of a geometric line
a group of buyers in a market
items.explanation: segment /ˈseɡ.mənt/ (danh từ): phân khúc (thị trường). "Market segment" = phân khúc thị trường, chia theo nhóm khách hàng mua, khác với user class chia theo công việc.
items.explanationEn: segment /ˈseɡ.mənt/ (noun): a group of buyers in a market. "Market segment" groups buyers, unlike a user class, which groups people by the tasks they perform.

items.question: Trong câu "They can be software agents performing a service on behalf of a human: bots that scan networks for information, software that monitors systems, or data-mining programs.", từ "on behalf of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They can be software agents performing a service on behalf of a human: bots that scan networks for information, software that monitors systems, or data-mining programs.", what does "on behalf of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on behalf of /ɑːn bɪˈhæf əv/ (cụm từ): thay mặt cho. "Act on behalf of someone" = hành động thay mặt ai; bot làm việc thay cho con người.
items.explanationEn: on behalf of /ɑːn bɪˈhæf əv/ (phrase): acting for someone. "Act on behalf of someone" means doing something as their representative, as bots do for humans.

items.question: Trong câu "Favored does not mean the group paying for the system or the one with the most political clout.", từ "clout" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Favored does not mean the group paying for the system or the one with the most political clout.", what does "clout" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: clout /klaʊt/ (danh từ): thế lực, tầm ảnh hưởng. "Political clout" = thế lực, sức ảnh hưởng trong tổ chức; nhóm favored không phụ thuộc vào điều này.
items.explanationEn: clout /klaʊt/ (noun): power and influence. "Political clout" is influence inside an organization; being favored does not depend on it.

items.question: Trong câu "at the risk of inconveniencing forgetful legitimate users.", từ "inconvenience" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "at the risk of inconveniencing forgetful legitimate users.", what does "inconvenience" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inconvenience /ˌɪn.kənˈviː.njəns/ (động từ): gây phiền toái. "At the risk of inconveniencing someone" = chấp nhận nguy cơ gây bất tiện cho ai đó.
items.explanationEn: inconvenience /ˌɪn.kənˈviː.njəns/ (verb): to cause trouble for. "At the risk of inconveniencing someone" means accepting that it may cause them trouble.

items.question: Trong câu "CAPTCHA exists to block disruptive bots.", từ "disruptive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CAPTCHA exists to block disruptive bots.", what does "disruptive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: disruptive /dɪsˈrʌp.tɪv/ (tính từ): gây rối, phá rối. "Disruptive bots" = bot phá rối hệ thống; trong kinh doanh "disruptive technology" lại là công nghệ đột phá.
items.explanationEn: disruptive /dɪsˈrʌp.tɪv/ (adjective): causing trouble or disorder. "Disruptive bots" cause disorder; in business, "disruptive technology" means a radically innovative one.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not overlook indirect user classes.", từ "overlook" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not overlook indirect user classes.", what does "overlook" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overlook /ˌoʊ.vɚˈlʊk/ (động từ): bỏ sót, không để ý. "Overlook something" = bỏ sót điều gì; nghĩa khác: "a room overlooking the sea" (nhìn ra biển).
items.explanationEn: overlook /ˌoʊ.vɚˈlʊk/ (verb): to fail to notice. "Overlook something" means failing to notice it; another sense is "a room overlooking the sea".

items.question: Trong câu "The goal: pare the list down to about 15 user classes or fewer.", từ "pare down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The goal: pare the list down to about 15 user classes or fewer.", what does "pare down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: pare down /per daʊn/ (cụm từ): cắt giảm dần. "Pare something down to" = cắt gọt, giảm bớt xuống còn bao nhiêu.
items.explanationEn: pare down /per daʊn/ (phrase): to reduce gradually. "Pare something down to" a number means trimming it until only that many remain.

items.question: Trong câu "A persona is a description of a hypothetical, generic person who stands in for a user class.", từ "hypothetical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A persona is a description of a hypothetical, generic person who stands in for a user class.", what does "hypothetical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hypothetical /ˌhaɪ.pəˈθet̬.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): giả định, giả tưởng. "A hypothetical person" = một người giả định; "hypothetical scenario" = tình huống giả định.
items.explanationEn: hypothetical /ˌhaɪ.pəˈθet̬.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): imagined, not real. "A hypothetical person" is imagined; "a hypothetical scenario" is a supposed situation.

items.question: Trong câu "Personas make thinking about requirements tangible rather than vague speculation about a faceless group.", từ "tangible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Personas make thinking about requirements tangible rather than vague speculation about a faceless group.", what does "tangible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tangible /ˈtæn.dʒə.bəl/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "Make something tangible" = làm cho điều gì trở nên cụ thể, dễ nắm bắt; trái nghĩa với "vague".
items.explanationEn: tangible /ˈtæn.dʒə.bəl/ (adjective): concrete. "Make something tangible" means making it concrete and easy to grasp; the opposite of "vague".

items.question: Trong câu "A persona can serve as a placeholder when the BA has no actual user representative at hand", từ "placeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A persona can serve as a placeholder when the BA has no actual user representative at hand", what does "placeholder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: placeholder /ˈpleɪsˌhoʊl.dɚ/ (danh từ): vật thay thế tạm. "Serve as a placeholder" = đóng vai trò thay thế tạm cho đến khi có thứ thật; trong UI "placeholder text" là chữ gợi ý trong ô nhập.
items.explanationEn: placeholder /ˈpleɪsˌhoʊl.dɚ/ (noun): a temporary stand-in. "Serve as a placeholder" means standing in until the real thing is available; in UI, "placeholder text" is hint text.

items.question: Trong câu "Make sure personas are truly representative, based on market, demographic, and ethnographic research rather than imagination.", từ "representative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Make sure personas are truly representative, based on market, demographic, and ethnographic research rather than imagination.", what does "representative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: representative /ˌrep.rɪˈzen.t̬ə.t̬ɪv/ (tính từ): tiêu biểu, đại diện. "Truly representative" = thực sự tiêu biểu cho nhóm; danh từ "representative" = người đại diện.
items.explanationEn: representative /ˌrep.rɪˈzen.t̬ə.t̬ɪv/ (adjective): typical of a group. "Truly representative" means typical of the whole group; as a noun, "representative" means a delegate.

items.question: Trong câu "A product champion is the primary interface between the members of one user class and the project BA.", từ "interface" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A product champion is the primary interface between the members of one user class and the project BA.", what does "interface" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interface /ˈɪn.t̬ɚ.feɪs/ (danh từ): đầu mối liên lạc. Ở đây "interface" chỉ người làm cầu nối giữa hai bên; trong phần mềm nó thường nghĩa là giao diện.
items.explanationEn: interface /ˈɪn.t̬ɚ.feɪs/ (noun): a person linking two groups. Here "interface" means a person connecting two sides; in software it usually means a user or system interface.

items.question: Trong câu "Ideally the champion is an actual user, not a surrogate such as a funding sponsor, marketing staffer, user manager, or a developer imagining themselves as a user.", từ "surrogate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Ideally the champion is an actual user, not a surrogate such as a funding sponsor, marketing staffer, user manager, or a developer imagining themselves as a user.", what does "surrogate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: surrogate /ˈsɝː.ə.ɡət/ (danh từ): người thay thế. "A surrogate" = người đứng thay cho người thật; ở đây là người không phải người dùng thực.
items.explanationEn: surrogate /ˈsɝː.ə.ɡət/ (noun): a stand-in. "A surrogate" stands in for the real person; here, someone who is not an actual user.

items.question: Trong câu "Champions gather requirements from other members of the user class they represent and reconcile inconsistencies within that group.", từ "reconcile" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Champions gather requirements from other members of the user class they represent and reconcile inconsistencies within that group.", what does "reconcile" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reconcile /ˈrek.ən.saɪl/ (động từ): dung hòa, làm khớp. "Reconcile inconsistencies" = xử lý cho các điểm mâu thuẫn khớp nhau; "reconcile accounts" = đối soát sổ sách.
items.explanationEn: reconcile /ˈrek.ən.saɪl/ (verb): to make agree. "Reconcile inconsistencies" means making conflicting points agree; "reconcile accounts" means matching records.

items.question: Trong câu "A clear vision of the new system and enthusiasm, because they see how it benefits them and their peers.", từ "enthusiasm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A clear vision of the new system and enthusiasm, because they see how it benefits them and their peers.", what does "enthusiasm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: enthusiasm /ɪnˈθuː.zi.æz.əm/ (danh từ): sự nhiệt tình. "Enthusiasm for something" = sự hào hứng với điều gì; tính từ: enthusiastic.
items.explanationEn: enthusiasm /ɪnˈθuː.zi.æz.əm/ (noun): eager interest. "Enthusiasm for something" is eager interest in it; the adjective is "enthusiastic".

items.question: Trong câu "It is hard enough to write good requirements if you do it for a living; it is not realistic to expect users who have never written requirements to do a good job.", từ "for a living" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is hard enough to write good requirements if you do it for a living; it is not realistic to expect users who have never written requirements to do a good job.", what does "for a living" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: for a living /fɔːr ə ˈlɪv.ɪŋ/ (cụm từ): làm nghề kiếm sống. "Do something for a living" = làm việc gì như nghề nghiệp; "What do you do for a living?" = Bạn làm nghề gì?
items.explanationEn: for a living /fɔːr ə ˈlɪv.ɪŋ/ (phrase): as your paid job. "Do something for a living" means it is your job; "What do you do for a living?" asks about someone's job.

items.question: Trong câu "For a very large user class, the champion can assemble a backup team of representatives from different subclasses.", từ "assemble" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a very large user class, the champion can assemble a backup team of representatives from different subclasses.", what does "assemble" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assemble /əˈsem.bəl/ (động từ): tập hợp, lập (nhóm). "Assemble a team" = tập hợp một nhóm; nghĩa khác: "assemble a computer" (lắp ráp máy tính).
items.explanationEn: assemble /əˈsem.bəl/ (verb): to bring people together. "Assemble a team" means gathering people; another sense is "assemble a computer" from parts.

items.question: Trong câu "The champion always strives for consensus, but willingly makes the call when agreement is not reached, so the project can move ahead.", từ "consensus" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The champion always strives for consensus, but willingly makes the call when agreement is not reached, so the project can move ahead.", what does "consensus" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consensus /kənˈsen.səs/ (danh từ): sự đồng thuận. "Strive for consensus" = cố gắng đạt được sự đồng thuận; "reach a consensus" = đạt đồng thuận.
items.explanationEn: consensus /kənˈsen.səs/ (noun): general agreement. "Strive for consensus" means trying to reach general agreement; also "reach a consensus".

items.question: Trong câu "Managers overriding decisions made by a qualified, duly authorized champion — leaving users dissatisfied and champions frustrated.", từ "override" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Managers overriding decisions made by a qualified, duly authorized champion — leaving users dissatisfied and champions frustrated.", what does "override" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: override /ˌoʊ.vɚˈraɪd/ (động từ): gạt bỏ, bác bỏ. "Override a decision" = dùng quyền cao hơn để gạt bỏ quyết định; trong lập trình "override a method" = ghi đè phương thức.
items.explanationEn: override /ˌoʊ.vɚˈraɪd/ (verb): to set aside by authority. "Override a decision" means cancelling it with higher authority; in programming you "override a method".

items.question: Trong câu "A champion who lacks a clear vision and defers all decisions to the BA.", từ "defer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A champion who lacks a clear vision and defers all decisions to the BA.", what does "defer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defer /dɪˈfɝː/ (động từ): nhường (quyết định) cho. "Defer to someone" = nhường quyền quyết định cho ai; nghĩa khác: "defer a payment" (hoãn thanh toán).
items.explanationEn: defer /dɪˈfɝː/ (verb): to leave a choice to. "Defer to someone" means letting them decide; another sense is "defer a payment" (postpone it).

items.question: Trong câu "Someone who purports to speak for a user class they do not belong to.", từ "purport" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Someone who purports to speak for a user class they do not belong to.", what does "purport" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: purport /pɚˈpɔːrt/ (động từ): tự nhận là, cho là. "Purport to be/do" = tự nhận là (thường không đúng sự thật).
items.explanationEn: purport /pɚˈpɔːrt/ (verb): to claim, often falsely. "Purport to be or do something" means claiming it, often without it being true.

items.question: Trong câu "Offer economic incentives: product discounts, or paying for their time.", từ "incentive" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Offer economic incentives: product discounts, or paying for their time.", what does "incentive" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: incentive /ɪnˈsen.t̬ɪv/ (danh từ): sự khuyến khích, ưu đãi. "Economic incentives" = ưu đãi kinh tế nhằm khuyến khích ai làm gì.
items.explanationEn: incentive /ɪnˈsen.t̬ɪv/ (noun): a reward that motivates. "Economic incentives" are financial rewards that encourage people to act.

items.question: Trong câu "They span all three requirement levels — business, user, and functional — essentially straddling the product champion and business analyst functions.", từ "straddle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They span all three requirement levels — business, user, and functional — essentially straddling the product champion and business analyst functions.", what does "straddle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: straddle /ˈstræd.əl/ (động từ): đảm nhận cả hai phía. "Straddle two roles" = kiêm nhiệm, nằm vắt ngang cả hai vai trò; nghĩa gốc là ngồi dạng chân hai bên.
items.explanationEn: straddle /ˈstræd.əl/ (verb): to cover both sides. "Straddle two roles" means covering both at once; literally it means sitting with a leg on each side.

items.question: Trong câu "The two models are not mutually exclusive.", từ "mutually exclusive" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The two models are not mutually exclusive.", what does "mutually exclusive" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: mutually exclusive /ˈmjuː.tʃu.ə.li ɪkˈskluː.sɪv/ (cụm từ): loại trừ lẫn nhau. "Not mutually exclusive" = có thể dùng cùng nhau, không loại trừ nhau.
items.explanationEn: mutually exclusive /ˈmjuː.tʃu.ə.li ɪkˈskluː.sɪv/ (phrase): unable to coexist. "Not mutually exclusive" means both can exist or be used together.

items.question: Trong câu "There is no substitute for the right person, in the right role, in the right place, with the right attitude.", từ "substitute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is no substitute for the right person, in the right role, in the right place, with the right attitude.", what does "substitute" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: substitute /ˈsʌb.stə.tuːt/ (danh từ): thứ thay thế. "There is no substitute for X" = không gì thay thế được X.
items.explanationEn: substitute /ˈsʌb.stə.tuːt/ (noun): a thing used instead. "There is no substitute for X" means nothing can replace X.

items.question: Trong câu "Elicitation is the process of identifying the needs and constraints of the various stakeholders — the heart of requirements development.", từ "elicitation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Elicitation is the process of identifying the needs and constraints of the various stakeholders — the heart of requirements development.", what does "elicitation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: elicitation /iˌlɪs.əˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự khơi gợi, khai thác. "Requirements elicitation" = khai thác yêu cầu; động từ: elicit (khơi gợi, gợi ra).
items.explanationEn: elicitation /iˌlɪs.əˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): drawing out information. "Requirements elicitation" means drawing requirements out of people; the verb is "elicit".

items.question: Trong câu "Nor is it transcribing exactly what users say.", từ "transcribe" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nor is it transcribing exactly what users say.", what does "transcribe" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to write down word for word
items.explanation: transcribe /trænˈskraɪb/ (động từ): chép lại nguyên văn. "Transcribe what users say" = ghi chép nguyên văn lời người dùng; danh từ: transcript.
items.explanationEn: transcribe /trænˈskraɪb/ (verb): to write down word for word. "Transcribe what users say" means writing their words down exactly; the noun is "transcript".

items.question: Trong câu "It is perhaps the most challenging, critical, error-prone, and communication-intensive aspect of software development.", từ "error-prone" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is perhaps the most challenging, critical, error-prone, and communication-intensive aspect of software development.", what does "error-prone" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: error-prone /ˈer.ɚ proʊn/ (tính từ): dễ mắc lỗi. "-prone" = dễ bị; "error-prone" = dễ sai sót, tương tự "accident-prone".
items.explanationEn: error-prone /ˈer.ɚ proʊn/ (adjective): likely to have mistakes. The suffix "-prone" means likely to suffer something; compare "accident-prone".

items.question: Trong câu "Look for requirements that reflect obsolete or ineffective business processes or rules and keep them out of the new system.", từ "obsolete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Look for requirements that reflect obsolete or ineffective business processes or rules and keep them out of the new system.", what does "obsolete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: obsolete /ˌɑːb.səˈliːt/ (tính từ): lỗi thời. "Obsolete processes" = quy trình lỗi thời, không còn phù hợp; gần nghĩa với "outdated".
items.explanationEn: obsolete /ˌɑːb.səˈliːt/ (adjective): no longer in use. "Obsolete processes" are out of date and no longer useful; close to "outdated".

items.question: Trong câu "Use the vocabulary of the business domain, not technical jargon.", từ "jargon" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use the vocabulary of the business domain, not technical jargon.", what does "jargon" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: jargon /ˈdʒɑːr.ɡən/ (danh từ): biệt ngữ chuyên môn. "Technical jargon" = thuật ngữ chuyên môn khó hiểu với người ngoài ngành.
items.explanationEn: jargon /ˈdʒɑːr.ɡən/ (noun): specialist terms. "Technical jargon" is specialist language that outsiders find hard to understand.

items.question: Trong câu "Independent activities supplement what users present and reveal needed functionality that end users may not be aware of.", từ "supplement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Independent activities supplement what users present and reveal needed functionality that end users may not be aware of.", what does "supplement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supplement /ˈsʌp.lə.ment/ (động từ): bổ sung thêm. "Supplement X" = bổ sung cho X; danh từ "supplement" còn nghĩa là thực phẩm bổ sung.
items.explanationEn: supplement /ˈsʌp.lə.ment/ (verb): to add to. "Supplement X" means adding to X; as a noun it can also mean a dietary supplement.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not expect to hold a couple of workshops and declare victory.", từ "declare victory" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not expect to hold a couple of workshops and declare victory.", what does "declare victory" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: declare victory /dɪˈkler ˈvɪk.tɚ.i/ (cụm từ): tuyên bố đã xong. "Declare victory" = tuyên bố thành công (thường là quá sớm).
items.explanationEn: declare victory /dɪˈkler ˈvɪk.tɚ.i/ (phrase): to claim success. "Declare victory" means announcing success, often too early.

items.question: Trong câu "Build rapport: participants feel safer sharing thoughts one-on-one, especially about touchy topics.", từ "rapport" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Build rapport: participants feel safer sharing thoughts one-on-one, especially about touchy topics.", what does "rapport" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rapport /ræpˈɔːr/ (danh từ): sự gắn kết, tin cậy. "Build/establish rapport" = tạo sự thân thiện, tin tưởng; đừng nhầm với "report".
items.explanationEn: rapport /ræpˈɔːr/ (noun): a trusting relationship. "Build rapport" means creating trust and understanding; do not confuse it with "report".

items.question: Trong câu "Easier to obtain buy-in about participating than in a larger setting.", từ "buy-in" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Easier to obtain buy-in about participating than in a larger setting.", what does "buy-in" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: buy-in /ˈbaɪ.ɪn/ (danh từ): sự đồng thuận ủng hộ. "Get buy-in from stakeholders" = có được sự đồng ý và ủng hộ của các bên liên quan.
items.explanationEn: buy-in /ˈbaɪ.ɪn/ (noun): agreement and support. "Get buy-in from stakeholders" means gaining their agreement and support.

items.question: Trong câu "Even with one person the conversation easily drifts.", từ "drift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Even with one person the conversation easily drifts.", what does "drift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drift /drɪft/ (động từ): lạc đề dần. "The conversation drifts" = cuộc trao đổi dần lạc khỏi chủ đề; nghĩa gốc là trôi dạt.
items.explanationEn: drift /drɪft/ (verb): to move off topic. "The conversation drifts" means it slowly moves away from the topic; literally, to float along.

items.question: Trong câu "People can critique content more easily than create it — a draft gives them a starting point.", từ "critique" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People can critique content more easily than create it — a draft gives them a starting point.", what does "critique" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: critique /krɪˈtiːk/ (động từ): nhận xét, phê bình. "Critique a draft" = góp ý, đánh giá bản nháp; dễ hơn so với tự tạo từ đầu.
items.explanationEn: critique /krɪˈtiːk/ (verb): to evaluate. "Critique a draft" means evaluating it, which is easier than creating one from nothing.

items.question: Trong câu "Listen actively: lean forward, show patience, give verbal feedback, inquire when something is unclear, and paraphrase the main idea to show understanding.", từ "paraphrase" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Listen actively: lean forward, show patience, give verbal feedback, inquire when something is unclear, and paraphrase the main idea to show understanding.", what does "paraphrase" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: paraphrase /ˈper.ə.freɪz/ (động từ): diễn đạt lại. "Paraphrase the main idea" = nói lại ý chính bằng lời của mình để xác nhận đã hiểu.
items.explanationEn: paraphrase /ˈper.ə.freɪz/ (verb): to restate. "Paraphrase the main idea" means restating it in your own words to confirm understanding.

items.question: Trong câu "Rarely does it make sense to start a workshop with a completely blank slate.", từ "blank slate" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rarely does it make sense to start a workshop with a completely blank slate.", what does "blank slate" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: blank slate /blæŋk sleɪt/ (cụm từ): khởi đầu trống trơn. "Start with a blank slate" = bắt đầu từ con số không, chưa có gì chuẩn bị.
items.explanationEn: blank slate /blæŋk sleɪt/ (phrase): a fresh empty start. "Start with a blank slate" means beginning with nothing prepared.

items.question: Trong câu "Workshops with more than five or six active participants become mired in side trips, concurrent conversations, and bickering.", từ "mired" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Workshops with more than five or six active participants become mired in side trips, concurrent conversations, and bickering.", what does "mired" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mired /maɪrd/ (tính từ): sa lầy, bế tắc. "Become mired in something" = bị sa lầy vào điều gì, khó tiến lên.
items.explanationEn: mired /maɪrd/ (adjective): stuck and unable to progress. "Become mired in something" means getting stuck in it and unable to move forward.

items.question: Trong câu "A focus group is a representative group of users convened in a facilitated activity to generate input and ideas about a product functional and quality requirements.", từ "convene" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A focus group is a representative group of users convened in a facilitated activity to generate input and ideas about a product functional and quality requirements.", what does "convene" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convene /kənˈviːn/ (động từ): triệu tập, tụ họp. "Convene a meeting/group" = triệu tập một cuộc họp hoặc một nhóm người.
items.explanationEn: convene /kənˈviːn/ (verb): to call together. "Convene a meeting or group" means calling people together for it.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not expect quantitative analysis — the output is a lot of subjective feedback that must be further evaluated and prioritized.", từ "quantitative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not expect quantitative analysis — the output is a lot of subjective feedback that must be further evaluated and prioritized.", what does "quantitative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: quantitative /ˈkwɑːn.t̬ə.teɪ.t̬ɪv/ (tính từ): định lượng. "Quantitative analysis" = phân tích định lượng (dựa trên số liệu); đối lập với "qualitative" (định tính).
items.explanationEn: quantitative /ˈkwɑːn.t̬ə.teɪ.t̬ɪv/ (adjective): based on numbers. "Quantitative analysis" works with measurable numbers; the opposite is "qualitative".

items.question: Trong câu "Why: tasks are complex and hard to recall fully, users are so familiar they cannot articulate it, or the task is so habitual they no longer think about it.", từ "habitual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why: tasks are complex and hard to recall fully, users are so familiar they cannot articulate it, or the task is so habitual they no longer think about it.", what does "habitual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: habitual /həˈbɪtʃ.u.əl/ (tính từ): thành thói quen. "A habitual task" = việc làm theo thói quen đến mức không còn để ý các bước.
items.explanationEn: habitual /həˈbɪtʃ.u.əl/ (adjective): done by habit. "A habitual task" is done so routinely that people no longer notice the steps.

items.question: Trong câu "They are inexpensive, a logical choice for large user populations, and easy to administer across geographical boundaries.", từ "administer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are inexpensive, a logical choice for large user populations, and easy to administer across geographical boundaries.", what does "administer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: administer /ədˈmɪn.ə.stɚ/ (động từ): tổ chức thực hiện. "Administer a questionnaire/test" = tổ chức cho người khác làm bảng hỏi/bài kiểm tra; nghĩa khác: "administer a drug".
items.explanationEn: administer /ədˈmɪn.ə.stɚ/ (verb): to carry out or run. "Administer a questionnaire or test" means running it; another sense is "administer a drug".

items.question: Trong câu "Analysed results feed other techniques — for example use a questionnaire to identify the biggest pain points with an existing system, then discuss prioritization in a workshop.", từ "pain point" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysed results feed other techniques — for example use a questionnaire to identify the biggest pain points with an existing system, then discuss prioritization in a workshop.", what does "pain point" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pain point /ˈpeɪn ˌpɔɪnt/ (danh từ): vấn đề gây khó chịu. "Pain points" = những điểm gây bức xúc, khó khăn cho người dùng hoặc khách hàng.
items.explanationEn: pain point /ˈpeɪn ˌpɔɪnt/ (noun): a recurring problem. "Pain points" are the problems that frustrate users or customers most.

items.question: Trong câu "Make choices mutually exclusive (no overlapping numeric ranges) and exhaustive (list every possibility, or provide a write-in).", từ "exhaustive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Make choices mutually exclusive (no overlapping numeric ranges) and exhaustive (list every possibility, or provide a write-in).", what does "exhaustive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: exhaustive /ɪɡˈzɑː.stɪv/ (tính từ): đầy đủ, bao quát hết. "Exhaustive list" = danh sách đầy đủ mọi khả năng; đừng nhầm với "exhausting" (mệt nhoài).
items.explanationEn: exhaustive /ɪɡˈzɑː.stɪv/ (adjective): covering every case. "An exhaustive list" covers every possibility; do not confuse it with "exhausting" (very tiring).

items.question: Trong câu "Do not phrase a question in a way that implies a "correct" answer.", từ "imply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not phrase a question in a way that implies a "correct" answer.", what does "imply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (động từ): ngụ ý, hàm ý. "Imply an answer" = gợi ý ngầm một câu trả lời; tính từ "implied" = ngầm định.
items.explanationEn: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (verb): to suggest indirectly. "Imply an answer" means suggesting it without stating it; the adjective is "implied".

items.question: Trong câu "It is frustrating to learn too late that a question was ambiguous or that an important one was omitted.", từ "ambiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is frustrating to learn too late that a question was ambiguous or that an important one was omitted.", what does "ambiguous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, nhiều nghĩa. "An ambiguous question" = câu hỏi có thể hiểu theo nhiều cách; danh từ: ambiguity.
items.explanationEn: ambiguous /æmˈbɪɡ.ju.əs/ (adjective): open to several meanings. "An ambiguous question" can be understood in more than one way; the noun is "ambiguity".

items.question: Trong câu "The biggest payoff is discovering functionality you do NOT need to build.", từ "payoff" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The biggest payoff is discovering functionality you do NOT need to build.", what does "payoff" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: payoff /ˈpeɪ.ɑːf/ (danh từ): lợi ích thu được. "The biggest payoff" = lợi ích lớn nhất đạt được từ một nỗ lực.
items.explanationEn: payoff /ˈpeɪ.ɑːf/ (noun): a benefit gained. "The biggest payoff" is the greatest benefit you get from an effort.

items.question: Trong câu "For purchased packages, the vendor user manuals often contain screen shots that work fine as a starting point.", từ "vendor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For purchased packages, the vendor user manuals often contain screen shots that work fine as a starting point.", what does "vendor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: vendor /ˈven.dɚ/ (danh từ): nhà cung cấp. "Software vendor" = nhà cung cấp phần mềm; "vendor lock-in" = bị phụ thuộc vào một nhà cung cấp.
items.explanationEn: vendor /ˈven.dɚ/ (noun): a supplier. "Software vendor" is the company selling software; "vendor lock-in" means depending on one supplier.

items.question: Trong câu "For a replacement system, past documentation can reveal functionality to retain as well as obsolete functionality.", từ "retain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a replacement system, past documentation can reveal functionality to retain as well as obsolete functionality.", what does "retain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (động từ): giữ lại. "Functionality to retain" = chức năng cần giữ lại; "data retention" = lưu giữ dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep. "Functionality to retain" is what should be kept; "data retention" means keeping data.

items.question: Trong câu "Only by gaining explicit commitment on resources, schedule, and deliverables can you avoid having participants pulled away to other work.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Only by gaining explicit commitment on resources, schedule, and deliverables can you avoid having participants pulled away to other work.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt/ (tính từ): rõ ràng, minh bạch. "Explicit commitment" = cam kết được nói rõ ràng; trái nghĩa: "implicit" (ngầm).
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt/ (adjective): stated clearly. "Explicit commitment" is clearly stated; the opposite is "implicit".

items.question: Trong câu "Elicitation risks — factors that could impede progress, their severity, and how to mitigate them.", từ "impede" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Elicitation risks — factors that could impede progress, their severity, and how to mitigate them.", what does "impede" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: impede /ɪmˈpiːd/ (động từ): cản trở. "Impede progress" = cản trở tiến độ; danh từ: impediment (trở ngại).
items.explanationEn: impede /ɪmˈpiːd/ (verb): to hinder. "Impede progress" means slowing or blocking it; the noun is "impediment".

items.question: Trong câu "Elicitation risks — factors that could impede progress, their severity, and how to mitigate them.", từ "mitigate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Elicitation risks — factors that could impede progress, their severity, and how to mitigate them.", what does "mitigate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mitigate /ˈmɪt̬.ə.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): giảm nhẹ. "Mitigate a risk" = giảm thiểu rủi ro; "risk mitigation" = kế hoạch giảm thiểu rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: mitigate /ˈmɪt̬.ə.ɡeɪt/ (verb): to lessen. "Mitigate a risk" means making it less severe; "risk mitigation" is the related noun phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Many BAs have a go-to technique — usually interviews and workshops — and do not think to use others that could reduce resource needs or increase information quality.", từ "go-to" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many BAs have a go-to technique — usually interviews and workshops — and do not think to use others that could reduce resource needs or increase information quality.", what does "go-to" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: go-to /ˈɡoʊ.tuː/ (tính từ): quen dùng nhất. "A go-to technique" = kỹ thuật luôn tìm đến đầu tiên; "go-to person" = người hay được nhờ.
items.explanationEn: go-to /ˈɡoʊ.tuː/ (adjective): relied on most often. "A go-to technique" is the one you always reach for first; also "a go-to person".

items.question: Trong câu "Or play the role of an apprentice so the user leads the discussion.", từ "apprentice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Or play the role of an apprentice so the user leads the discussion.", what does "apprentice" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: apprentice /əˈpren.t̬ɪs/ (danh từ): người học việc. "Play the role of an apprentice" = đóng vai người học việc, để người dùng dẫn dắt như thầy.
items.explanationEn: apprentice /əˈpren.t̬ɪs/ (noun): a learner of a trade. "Play the role of an apprentice" means acting as a learner so the user teaches you.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not be rigid about the script.", từ "rigid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not be rigid about the script.", what does "rigid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rigid /ˈrɪdʒ.ɪd/ (tính từ): cứng nhắc. "Be rigid about something" = cứng nhắc về điều gì; trái nghĩa: "flexible".
items.explanationEn: rigid /ˈrɪdʒ.ɪd/ (adjective): inflexible. "Be rigid about something" means refusing to adapt it; the opposite is "flexible".

items.question: Trong câu "this surfaces expectations for the successor.", từ "successor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "this surfaces expectations for the successor.", what does "successor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: successor /səkˈses.ɚ/ (danh từ): hệ thống kế nhiệm. "The successor" = cái thay thế kế tiếp (ở đây là hệ thống mới); trái nghĩa: "predecessor".
items.explanationEn: successor /səkˈses.ɚ/ (noun): the thing that follows. "The successor" is what comes next to replace something; the opposite is "predecessor".

items.question: Trong câu "Exploit the physical space.", từ "exploit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exploit the physical space.", what does "exploit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exploit /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ (động từ): tận dụng. "Exploit the space" = tận dụng tối đa không gian; trong bảo mật "exploit a vulnerability" = khai thác lỗ hổng.
items.explanationEn: exploit /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ (verb): to make full use of. "Exploit the space" means using it fully; in security, "exploit a vulnerability" means abusing a flaw.

items.question: Trong câu "Notes should contain the attendee list, invitees who did not attend, decisions made, actions and owners, outstanding issues, and the high points of key discussions.", từ "outstanding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Notes should contain the attendee list, invitees who did not attend, decisions made, actions and owners, outstanding issues, and the high points of key discussions.", what does "outstanding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: outstanding /ˌaʊtˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): còn tồn đọng. "Outstanding issues" = các vấn đề còn tồn đọng; nghĩa khác: "outstanding work" (công việc xuất sắc).
items.explanationEn: outstanding /ˌaʊtˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (adjective): not yet resolved. "Outstanding issues" are still unresolved; another sense is "outstanding work" (excellent).

items.question: Trong câu "Consolidate and organise your notes from multiple sources.", từ "consolidate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Consolidate and organise your notes from multiple sources.", what does "consolidate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consolidate /kənˈsɑː.lə.deɪt/ (động từ): hợp nhất, gom lại. "Consolidate notes" = gom ghi chép từ nhiều nguồn thành một bản thống nhất.
items.explanationEn: consolidate /kənˈsɑː.lə.deɪt/ (verb): to combine into one. "Consolidate notes" means combining notes from several sources into one set.

items.question: Trong câu "Editing carries a risk: you might misremember what something meant and unknowingly change the meaning.", từ "unknowingly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Editing carries a risk: you might misremember what something meant and unknowingly change the meaning.", what does "unknowingly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: unknowingly /ʌnˈnoʊ.ɪŋ.li/ (trạng từ): vô tình, không hay biết. "Unknowingly change something" = thay đổi mà không nhận ra; trái nghĩa: "knowingly".
items.explanationEn: unknowingly /ʌnˈnoʊ.ɪŋ.li/ (adverb): without realizing. "Unknowingly change something" means changing it without realizing; the opposite is "knowingly".

items.question: Trong câu "Do not expect customers to present a succinct, complete, well-organised list of needs.", từ "succinct" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not expect customers to present a succinct, complete, well-organised list of needs.", what does "succinct" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: succinct /səkˈsɪŋkt/ (tính từ): ngắn gọn, súc tích. "A succinct list" = danh sách ngắn gọn mà đủ ý; gần nghĩa với "concise".
items.explanationEn: succinct /səkˈsɪŋkt/ (adjective): brief and clear. "A succinct list" is short but clear; close in meaning to "concise".

items.question: Trong câu "The BA must classify myriad bits of information so each can be documented and used appropriately.", từ "myriad" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA must classify myriad bits of information so each can be documented and used appropriately.", what does "myriad" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: myriad /ˈmɪr.i.əd/ (tính từ): vô số. "Myriad bits of information" = vô số mẩu thông tin; cũng dùng "a myriad of".
items.explanationEn: myriad /ˈmɪr.i.əd/ (adjective): countless. "Myriad bits of information" means a huge number of them; also used as "a myriad of".

items.question: Trong câu "A prudent BA asks "why from a drop-down list?"", từ "prudent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A prudent BA asks "why from a drop-down list?"", what does "prudent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: prudent /ˈpruː.dənt/ (tính từ): thận trọng, khôn ngoan. "A prudent BA" = BA thận trọng, biết cân nhắc trước khi chấp nhận một giải pháp.
items.explanationEn: prudent /ˈpruː.dənt/ (adjective): wise and careful. "A prudent BA" thinks carefully before accepting a proposed solution.

items.question: Trong câu "Embedding a solution creates a design constraint: it limits the requirement to being implemented in only one way.", từ "embed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Embedding a solution creates a design constraint: it limits the requirement to being implemented in only one way.", what does "embed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: embed /ɪmˈbed/ (động từ): đưa vào, gắn sẵn. "Embed a solution in a requirement" = gắn sẵn giải pháp vào yêu cầu; "embedded system" = hệ thống nhúng.
items.explanationEn: embed /ɪmˈbed/ (verb): to fix inside. "Embed a solution in a requirement" means building it into the requirement; compare "embedded system".

items.question: Trong câu "Some information will not fit any of the nine categories: project requirements (user training), project constraints (cost, schedule), assumptions and dependencies, historical or context-setting information, or extraneous information that adds no value.", từ "extraneous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Some information will not fit any of the nine categories: project requirements (user training), project constraints (cost, schedule), assumptions and dependencies, historical or context-setting information, or extraneous information that adds no value.", what does "extraneous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: extraneous /ɪkˈstreɪ.ni.əs/ (tính từ): không liên quan, thừa. "Extraneous information" = thông tin ngoài lề, không đem lại giá trị.
items.explanationEn: extraneous /ɪkˈstreɪ.ni.əs/ (adjective): irrelevant or unneeded. "Extraneous information" is irrelevant material that adds no value.

items.question: Trong câu "Cues that you are reaching the point of diminishing returns:", từ "diminishing returns" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cues that you are reaching the point of diminishing returns:", what does "diminishing returns" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: diminishing returns /dɪˈmɪn.ɪ.ʃɪŋ rɪˈtɝːnz/ (cụm từ): lợi ích giảm dần. "The point of diminishing returns" = điểm mà bỏ thêm công sức thì thu về ngày càng ít.
items.explanationEn: diminishing returns /dɪˈmɪn.ɪ.ʃɪŋ rɪˈtɝːnz/ (phrase): shrinking gains from effort. "The point of diminishing returns" is where extra effort brings less and less benefit.

items.question: Trong câu "Suggested features and requirements are all deemed out of scope.", từ "deem" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Suggested features and requirements are all deemed out of scope.", what does "deem" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deem /diːm/ (động từ): coi là, cho là. "Be deemed out of scope" = bị coi là nằm ngoài phạm vi.
items.explanationEn: deem /diːm/ (verb): to judge. "Be deemed out of scope" means being judged to lie outside the scope.

items.question: Trong câu "Collecting from too few people, or hearing only the loudest, most opinionated customer.", từ "opinionated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Collecting from too few people, or hearing only the loudest, most opinionated customer.", what does "opinionated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: opinionated /əˈpɪn.jə.neɪ.t̬ɪd/ (tính từ): khăng khăng ý mình. "An opinionated customer" = khách hàng luôn khẳng định mạnh mẽ quan điểm riêng.
items.explanationEn: opinionated /əˈpɪn.jə.neɪ.t̬ɪd/ (adjective): insisting on own views. "An opinionated customer" strongly pushes their own views.

items.question: Trong câu "Between analysis and design lies a gray area, not a sharp line.", từ "gray area" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Between analysis and design lies a gray area, not a sharp line.", what does "gray area" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: gray area /ɡreɪ ˈer.i.ə/ (cụm từ): vùng ranh giới mập mờ. "A gray area" = vùng không rõ ràng đúng/sai hay thuộc bên nào.
items.explanationEn: gray area /ɡreɪ ˈer.i.ə/ (phrase): an unclear middle zone. "A gray area" is a situation where the boundary or rule is unclear.

items.question: Trong câu "Does a vague, high-level requirement need fleshing out so stakeholders understand it the same way?", từ "flesh out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does a vague, high-level requirement need fleshing out so stakeholders understand it the same way?", what does "flesh out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: flesh out /fleʃ aʊt/ (cụm từ): bổ sung chi tiết. "Flesh out a requirement" = bổ sung chi tiết cho một yêu cầu còn sơ sài.
items.explanationEn: flesh out /fleʃ aʊt/ (phrase): to add more detail. "Flesh out a requirement" means adding detail to a thin or vague one.

items.question: Trong câu "Is a requirement that belongs to a logical pair (saving an incomplete web form) missing its counterpart (retrieving a saved form)?", từ "counterpart" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Is a requirement that belongs to a logical pair (saving an incomplete web form) missing its counterpart (retrieving a saved form)?", what does "counterpart" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: counterpart /ˈkaʊn.t̬ɚ.pɑːrt/ (danh từ): vế tương ứng. "Its counterpart" = phần đối ứng đi cặp với nó (lưu ↔ lấy lại).
items.explanationEn: counterpart /ˈkaʊn.t̬ɚ.pɑːrt/ (noun): a matching other half. "Its counterpart" is the matching item in a pair, such as save and retrieve.

items.question: Trong câu "A little more specification and dialogue would have avoided considerable rework.", từ "rework" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A little more specification and dialogue would have avoided considerable rework.", what does "rework" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rework /ˈriː.wɝːk/ (danh từ): việc phải làm lại. "Considerable rework" = khối lượng làm lại đáng kể do yêu cầu thiếu sót.
items.explanationEn: rework /ˈriː.wɝːk/ (noun): work done again. "Considerable rework" is a large amount of work that must be redone.

items.question: Trong câu "Decompose high-level requirements into enough detail to reveal exactly what is being requested.", từ "decompose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Decompose high-level requirements into enough detail to reveal exactly what is being requested.", what does "decompose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decompose /ˌdiː.kəmˈpoʊz/ (động từ): phân rã, chia nhỏ. "Decompose X into Y" = chia nhỏ X thành các phần Y; nghĩa khác: xác hữu cơ phân hủy.
items.explanationEn: decompose /ˌdiː.kəmˈpoʊz/ (verb): to break into parts. "Decompose X into Y" means breaking X into parts Y; another sense is organic matter rotting.

items.question: Trong câu "Watch out for analysis paralysis — spending too much time on elicitation trying to avoid missing any requirement.", từ "analysis paralysis" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Watch out for analysis paralysis — spending too much time on elicitation trying to avoid missing any requirement.", what does "analysis paralysis" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: analysis paralysis /əˈnæl.ə.sɪs pəˈræl.ə.sɪs/ (cụm từ): phân tích mãi không tiến. "Analysis paralysis" = tình trạng phân tích quá mức đến mức không ra quyết định hay tiến lên được.
items.explanationEn: analysis paralysis /əˈnæl.ə.sɪs pəˈræl.ə.sɪs/ (phrase): overthinking that stalls work. "Analysis paralysis" is analysing so much that no decision or progress happens.

items.question: Trong câu "Disfavored user classes lead to features that deliberately make things hard for them, like account lockout or CAPTCHA.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Disfavored user classes lead to features that deliberately make things hard for them, like account lockout or CAPTCHA.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ɚ.ət.li/ (trạng từ): cố ý. "Deliberately make things hard" = cố tình gây khó khăn.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ɚ.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose. "Deliberately make things hard" means doing so on purpose.

items.question: Trong câu "Workshops with more than five or six active participants bog down; run parallel workshops instead.", từ "bog down" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Workshops with more than five or six active participants bog down; run parallel workshops instead.", what does "bog down" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: bog down /bɑːɡ daʊn/ (cụm từ): bị sa lầy. "Bog down" = bị sa lầy, chậm lại; thường gặp "get bogged down in details".
items.explanationEn: bog down /bɑːɡ daʊn/ (phrase): to get stuck. "Bog down" means getting stuck and slowing; often "get bogged down in details".

items.question: Trong câu "The product champion (or product owner) structure brings the user voice into the project sustainably.", từ "sustainably" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The product champion (or product owner) structure brings the user voice into the project sustainably.", what does "sustainably" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: sustainably /səˈsteɪ.nə.bli/ (trạng từ): một cách bền vững. "Sustainably" = theo cách duy trì được lâu dài.
items.explanationEn: sustainably /səˈsteɪ.nə.bli/ (adverb): in a lasting way. "Sustainably" means in a way that can be maintained over time.

items.question: Trong câu "Follow up rigorously: consolidate notes, send them for review, and track every issue to closure.", từ "rigorously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Follow up rigorously: consolidate notes, send them for review, and track every issue to closure.", what does "rigorously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: rigorously /ˈrɪɡ.ɚ.əs.li/ (trạng từ): kỹ lưỡng, chặt chẽ. "Follow up rigorously" = theo sát một cách chặt chẽ, không bỏ sót.
items.explanationEn: rigorously /ˈrɪɡ.ɚ.əs.li/ (adverb): thoroughly and strictly. "Follow up rigorously" means following up thoroughly without skipping anything.

items.question: Trong câu "Classify customer input into the right buckets, and stay alert for solution ideas disguised as requirements.", từ "disguise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Classify customer input into the right buckets, and stay alert for solution ideas disguised as requirements.", what does "disguise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: disguise /dɪsˈɡaɪz/ (động từ): ngụy trang. "Disguised as requirements" = đội lốt yêu cầu, thực chất là ý tưởng giải pháp.
items.explanationEn: disguise /dɪsˈɡaɪz/ (verb): to hide the true nature. "Disguised as requirements" means looking like requirements while really being solution ideas.
